protocol: Sequential processes; alternating before/after order between passes. Each point is the median of seven calibrated batch averages. Fresh commit includes allocation/drop; verify includes the complete leaf and path. Input/proof preparation is outside timing. Case order is fixed within each process. Run spread is not a confidence interval.
